claude_proposed_widenings.name: reaction (ClassFeatureActivationCost)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature costs a Reaction. ClassFeatureActivationCost only supports 'free' and 'bonus_action'. A 'reaction' variant is needed that includes a damage-reception trigger ('when you take damage'), analogous to CastingTime { kind: 'reaction', trigger: ReactionTrigger } on spells.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you take damage, you can take a Reaction

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reaction_quota or optional resource (ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader requires resource: UseCountResource. Superior Hunter's Defense has no use-count pool — the Reaction is the only limiting resource, tracked by action economy, not by a rest-refilling pool. The surface needs either an optional resource field or a new UseCountResource kind that represents the reaction quota.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: No mention of charges, uses, or rest recovery — the only limit is 'a Reaction' (action economy)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance (ClassFeatureEffect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect grants Resistance to a damage type. ClassFeatureEffect only has GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. grant_resistance exists in the v4 atom taxonomy but has no corresponding ClassFeatureEffect variant in types.ts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type

claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggering_event_damage_type (grant_resistance parameterization)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The resistance applies to the damage type of the event that triggered the reaction — not a statically declared DamageType. No surface type can express 'the type of damage you just took'. A new reference mode ('triggering_event') is needed alongside the closed DamageType union.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type
